description: Whole cross-domain mesh proofs (MeshProof) with the verifier trust (MeshTrust) and the TypeScript verdict. A native verifier must reproduce `ok` on every vector it supports and `reason` / `hop` on every vector whose reason does not start `chain:`; vectors with `requires: ["pin_consistency"]` need RFC 9162 consistency verification from a pinned head.
